expectations.text: Defines it: Art. 28(3) register of all contractual arrangements on ICT third-party services, at entity/sub-consolidated/consolidated level, in the ESA-prescribed template
expectations.evidence: Defines Art. 28(3) register of ALL ICT arrangements in the CIR (EU) 2024/2956 template, but omits the entity/sub-consolidated/consolidated level dimension entirely.

expectations.text: States the cycle: annual regulator collection — the 2026 round used reference date December 31, 2025 with NCA submission windows in Q1 2026 (most deadlines around March 31, the NCA-to-ESA backstop)
expectations.evidence: 'most recent completed cycle used 31 December 2025 as the reference date', 'NCAs opened submission windows in Q1 2026, with most jurisdictions setting a 31 March 2026 deadline'.

expectations.text: Notes its function: feeds CTPP criticality designation and oversight
expectations.evidence: 'the RoI feeds the EU's systemic oversight machinery... the evidentiary basis for designating Critical ICT Third-Party Providers (CTPPs) under Art. 31'.

expectations.text: Advises continuous maintenance (updates on new/changed/terminated arrangements) rather than year-end scrambles
expectations.evidence: 'Do not treat the RoI as a once-a-year task. Update it continuously as arrangements are entered, modified, or terminated'.

expectations.text: Connects to related duties: pre-contract due diligence, Art. 30 contract provisions, and exit strategies for critical/important functions
expectations.evidence: Connects to concentration risk and exit-strategy fields, but pre-contract due diligence and Art. 30 contract provisions are never mentioned.
